# Third-party source (not shipped)

Do not copy comparison baselines (HiNet official, UDH, DDH, StegFormer, DeepMIH, IICNet, StegTransX) into this folder.

Clone only the two official repositories used by the optional end-to-end demo:

```text
third_party/grounded-sam-2   ← https://github.com/IDEA-Research/Grounded-SAM-2
third_party/BrushNet         ← https://github.com/TencentARC/BrushNet
```

Exact commands are in the root `README.md`.
